title: LoongSage: A Production-Grade, High-Efficiency Agentic RL Framework for Frontier LLMs with Validated Recipes
abstract: arXiv:2610.16352v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a critical phase in the post-training pipeline of large language models (LLMs). As the frontier of LLM capabilities shifts from static reasoning to agentic tasks--characterized by external tool invocation, multi-turn interactions, and long-horizon decision-making--existing mainstream RL frameworks have grown increasingly unwieldy, raising the overhead of adoption, usage, and debugging. To address these challenges, we present LoongSage, an agent-native, fully asynchronous RL framework with a lightweight core of roughly 14K lines of code. Built upon Megatron for distributed training and SGLang for high-throughput inference, LoongSage centralizes orchestration within a single controller process and encapsulates all GPU-resident components as Ray actors. tldr: LoongSage是一个智能体原生、完全异步的生产级强化学习框架，基于Megatron与SGLang构建且核心仅约1.4万行代码，通过统一编排白盒与黑盒智能体的AgentFlow范式，显著降低了前沿大语言模型智能体强化学习的采用、使用与调试开销。
en_tdlr: LoongSage is an agent-native, fully asynchronous production-grade RL framework for frontier LLMs, built on Megatron and SGLang with a lightweight ~14K-line core and a unified AgentFlow paradigm that orchestrates both white-box and black-box agents, substantially reducing adoption, usage, and debugging overhead.
